neighbours.label: The word 'independent' in any sense (organisation names, 'independent of', 'independent variable'), not its synonyms
fire: The report was written by the Independent Review Panel last spring.
She volunteers at the Independent Arts Center on Fifth Street.
After college he became financially independent of his family.
In this study, the independent variable was the amount of light.
An independent auditor checked the charity's accounts.
The film was made by a small independent studio in Austin.
The bookshop has stayed independent for forty years.
Two independent witnesses confirmed the driver's account.
quiet: The report was written by the National Review Panel last spring.
She volunteers at the Community Arts Center on Fifth Street.
After college he became financially separate from his family.
In this study, the controlled variable was the amount of light.
An outside auditor checked the charity's accounts.
The film was made by a small family studio in Austin.
The bookshop has stayed autonomous for forty years.
Two separate witnesses confirmed the driver's account.

predictions: Fire 0.33-0.75 on ' independent'/' Independent'; 'autonomous', 'separate', 'self-reliant' and other organisation names below 0.20.
